mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, u.username, o.product_id, p.name AS product_name, o.quantity, o.unit_price, o.total_price, o.status, o.address, o.ordered_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, u.username, o.product_id, p.name AS product_name, o.quantity, o.unit_price, o.total_price, o.status, o.address, o.ordered_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = ?

SELECT o.id, o.user_id, u.username, o.product_id, p.name AS product_name, o.quantity, o.unit_price, o.total_price, o.status, o.address, o.ordered_at FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = ? ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price, status, address, ordered_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', ?, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = ? WHERE id = ?
UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = ?
